max_miss.description: Maximum number of frames a track can be missed before being removed

target_class.description: List of target class names to detect

no_walking_zones.description: List of polygon zones where walking is not allowed

fps.description: Frame rate of the video stream

monitoring_duration_seconds.description: Duration in seconds to monitor after person enters no_walking_zone (T0)

pre_event_seconds.description: Seconds before T0 to include in event detections

mhe_iou_threshold.description: IOU threshold to count a frame as MHE intersecting (0.0-1.0)

mhe_intersect_percentage_threshold.description: If MHE intersection >= this % of frames, person is operating MHE, no violation

product_iou_threshold.description: IOU threshold to count a frame as product intersecting (0.0-1.0)

product_intersect_percentage_threshold.description: If product intersection >= this % of frames, person is handling product, no violation

cleaner_frame_threshold.description: cleaner_score threshold to count a frame as cleaner frame (0.0-1.0)

cleaner_percentage_threshold.description: If cleaner frames >= this % of total frames, person is a cleaner, no violation

distance_multiplier.description: Multiplier for avg bbox height to determine minimum distance traveled for violation (2/3 bbox height ≈ 1m)

proximity_multiplier.description: Multiplier for person bbox height to determine proximity distance to MHE/product. Scales with perspective.

confidence_score_alpha.description: Weight for mean detection confidence in final confidence score

confidence_score_beta.description: Weight for MHE score in final confidence score

confidence_score_gamma.description: Weight for product score in final confidence score
